title: Ain't No Rest for the Wicked
track: Ain't No Rest for the Wicked
lyrics:
[00:12.00]I was walking down the street
[00:13.38]When out the corner of my eye
[00:14.81]I saw a pretty little thing approaching me
[00:17.92]She said, "I've never seen a man, who looks so all alone
[00:21.13]Could you use a little company?
[00:23.92]If you pay the right price, your evening will be nice
[00:27.12]And you can go and send me on my way"
[00:30.17]I said, "You're such a sweet young thing, why you do this to yourself?"
[00:33.61]She looked at me and this is what she said
[00:36.35]Oh, there ain't no rest for the wicked
[00:39.77]Money don't grow on trees
[00:42.51]I got bills to pay, I got mouths to feed
[00:45.55]There ain't nothing in this world for free
[00:48.62]Oh no, I can't slow down, I can't hold back
[00:51.83]Though you know, I wish I could
[00:54.82]Oh, no there ain't no rest for the wicked
[00:57.86]Until we close our eyes for good
[01:01.00]Not even fifteen minutes later
[01:02.66]I'm still walking down the street
[01:03.92]When I saw the shadow of a man creep out of sight
[01:07.12]And then he swept up from behind
[01:08.69]He put a gun up to my head
[01:10.24]He made it clear he wasn't looking for a fight
[01:13.27]He said, "Give me all you've got
[01:14.80]I want your money, not your life
[01:16.40]But if you try to make a move, I won't think twice"
[01:19.31]I told him, "You can have my cash
[01:21.00]But first, you know I got to ask
[01:22.58]What made you want to live this kind of life?"
[01:25.47]He said, there ain't no rest for the wicked
[01:28.91]Money don't grow on trees
[01:31.60]I got bills to pay, I got mouths to feed
[01:34.62]There ain't nothing in this world for free
[01:37.56]Oh no, I can't slow down, I can't hold back
[01:41.13]Though you know, I wish I could
[01:44.08]Oh no, there ain't no rest for the wicked
[01:47.14]Until we close our eyes for good, yeah
[02:02.57]Well now a couple hours passed
[02:04.13]And I was sitting at my house
[02:05.48]The day was winding down and coming to an end
[02:08.69]And so I turned on the TV
[02:10.25]And flipped it over to the news
[02:11.68]And what I saw, I almost couldn't comprehend
[02:14.94]I saw a preacher man in cuffs
[02:16.38]He'd taken money from the church
[02:17.75]He'd stuffed his bank account with righteous dollar bills
[02:20.95]But even still, I can't say much
[02:22.49]Because I know we're all the same
[02:24.05]Oh yes, we all seek out to satisfy those thrills
[02:27.14]You know there ain't no rest for the wicked
[02:30.44]Money don't grow on trees
[02:33.30]We got bills to pay, we got mouths to feed
[02:36.29]There ain't nothing in this world for free
[02:39.44]No, we can't slow down, we can't hold back
[02:42.59]Though you know, we wish we could
[02:45.67]Oh no, there ain't no rest for the wicked
[02:48.60]Until we close our eyes for good
